title: Ashes
description: I remember a home engulfed in fire. Was it mine? It felt important somehow.

title: Smoke
description: I remember running through narrow stone streets. Flames everywhere. Shouting behind me. Nowhere to turn.

title: The Sky
description: The night sky glowed orange. I remember thinking the world itself was ending.

title: Torn Colors
description: A banner hanging in pieces from a shattered wall. I knew its colors once.

title: The Gates
description: Heavy impacts against iron gates. Each strike felt closer than the last.

title: The Last Hold
description: Someone said the outer walls had fallen. No one argued.

title: The Throne
description: An empty throne surrounded by silence. I remember staring at it for a long time.

title: No Orders
description: Someone kept asking for commands. No answer ever came.

title: Familiar Eyes
description: I keep seeing the same face in crowds. Familiar. Tired. Angry.

title: An Argument
description: A voice shouting at me through alarms and shaking walls. I could not understand the words, only the fear behind them.

title: Reaching Hand
description: Someone grabbed my arm. Not to hurt me. To stop me.

title: The Chamber
description: A room beneath the city. Strange machinery humming beneath stone and candlelight.

title: Impossible Shapes
description: Metal rings turning around empty space. Symbols burning brighter than fire.

title: They Were Afraid
description: The people in the chamber looked terrified. Not of the enemy outside. Of the machine itself.

title: It Wasn't Ready
description: I remember someone repeating the same words over and over: 'It was never meant to be used.'

title: White Light
description: A flash so bright it erased everything else.

title: Weightless
description: Falling without wind. Screaming without sound.

title: Shards
description: Something pierced through me. Burning. Cold. Alive.

title: The Split
description: I saw people torn away into darkness. Reaching for each other. Vanishing.

title: Not My Memory
description: Sometimes I remember places I know I have never seen.

title: Another Life
description: A child laughing beside a river. I do not know her name, but losing her hurts.

title: Borrowed Fear
description: For a moment I felt terror that did not belong to me.

title: Armor
description: My hands move like they remember battle even when my mind does not.

title: The Oath
description: I remember kneeling before someone important. I swore I would protect something.

title: Failure
description: A feeling heavier than grief. As if countless lives slipped through my hands.

title: The Word
description: I heard someone whisper a name with fear: 'Shardborne.'

title: Recognition
description: An old woman stared at me like she knew me from another lifetime.

title: The Marked
description: There are others like me. Broken in the same invisible way.

title: The Wanderers
description: A story about travelers appearing from nowhere during ancient disasters.

title: The Sleepless King
description: A ruined village spoke of a ruler who remembered things that never happened.

title: The Saint of Ash
description: An old prayer mentioned a figure who came from fire carrying the end of a world.

title: The Machine
description: I think... we built it.

title: We Caused This
description: The Syndrome did not exist before that night.

title: His Face
description: I finally remember the man trying to stop me.

title: Ashes in the Wind
description: A memory flickers briefly before dissolving into smoke.
loreText: Ash drifted through the air like black snow. I remember heat against my face... and the feeling that something precious was ending.

title: The Sound of Bells
description: A distant ringing echoes inside your mind.
loreText: Bells rang endlessly somewhere above me. Not celebration. Warning. People were screaming beneath them.

title: Fractured Banner
description: You remember carrying something heavy beneath smoke-filled skies.
loreText: A torn banner brushed against my shoulder. Red and gold... I think. Men around me were wounded, but still marching.

title: Nameless Brother
description: Someone stands beside you in the memory, though their face remains unclear.
loreText: There was always someone beside me. Laughing. Arguing. Bleeding. I cannot remember his name, and that frightens me more than the battle.

title: Sealed Chamber
description: A hidden room surfaces in your thoughts.
loreText: Stone walls. Strange machinery. The room trembled each time something struck the great door outside.

title: Voices Beyond the Door
description: You remember desperate shouting.
loreText: Someone yelled that the barricade would not hold. Another voice begged for more time.

title: The Device
description: An impossible object appears briefly in your thoughts.
loreText: Metal intertwined with crystal. Veins of light pulsed beneath its surface like a living heart.

title: Forbidden Words
description: Fragments of an argument echo in your mind.
loreText: "It was never meant to be used." I remember those words clearly. Someone sounded terrified.

title: A Desperate Choice
description: A feeling of urgency overwhelms you.
loreText: There was no time left. Everyone looked at me as if waiting for an answer I did not want to give.

title: Grasping Arm
description: The memory ends with sudden violence.
loreText: Someone grabbed my arm before I reached the light. I remember anger in his voice... and fear.

title: White Light
description: The memory burns too brightly to hold.
loreText: The world vanished beneath a flood of white. For a moment, I felt myself break apart.

title: Glass in the Skin
description: You instinctively touch your chest.
loreText: Something entered me during the explosion. Cold. Sharp. Alive.

title: Falling Without End
description: A sensation of endless descent fills your thoughts.
loreText: I fell through darkness for what felt like centuries. I saw places that could not exist.

title: Familiar Stranger
description: Someone you almost recognize appears briefly.
loreText: An old traveler stared at me with grief in his eyes. I almost knew him.

title: The Broken Crown
description: A shattered image flashes before your eyes.
loreText: A crown rested upon cracked stone. Abandoned. Forgotten. Waiting.

title: Whispers of the Shardborne
description: The name feels strangely familiar.
loreText: They whispered about the Shardborne Syndrome long before I understood why the words felt personal.

title: The Old Storykeeper
description: A memory not entirely your own surfaces.
loreText: An old woman spoke of travelers who appeared from fractures in the night sky generations ago.

title: Echoes of the Lost
description: You feel the presence of others.
loreText: We were not alone when the world broke. I know that now. Sometimes I hear them in my dreams.

title: The First Prophet
description: A strange figure appears in fragmented visions.
loreText: A man covered in glowing fractures warned entire villages about a coming catastrophe. They called him mad until the storms began.

title: The Knight Without Age
description: A rumor surfaces from forgotten history.
loreText: Some legends spoke of a warrior who never aged, wandering battlefields long after kingdoms had fallen.

title: Cities Beneath the Earth
description: A hidden civilization flickers in your thoughts.
loreText: Some who survived the fracture hid underground, terrified of what they had become.

title: The Other Side of Time
description: You glimpse something impossible.
loreText: I remember seeing him after the fall. Older. Changed. Watching me from across a ruined hall.

title: The Accusation
description: The memory leaves behind a feeling of guilt.
loreText: "Look at what you've done." I do not remember who said it... only that they were right.

title: The World That Should Not Exist
description: Reality itself feels wrong for a moment.
loreText: This world was not ours. I knew that immediately, though I cannot explain how.

title: The Last Command
description: A final order echoes through your mind.
loreText: "Protect the kingdom." Strange... I cannot even remember its name anymore.
